overreach: An oscilloscope used for this PCIe Gen5 validation needs enough timing / vertical measurement capability to resolve an eye height of 15 ± 1.5 mV and an eye width of 9.375 ± 0.5 ps
An oscilloscope intended to observe that PCIe Gen5 edge without becoming the limiting bandwidth element should have bandwidth on the order of 29 GHz or higher
the oscilloscope role is to support high-speed electrical interface / eye-diagram-style validation
review.reason: The cited passages support the measurable SI items, PCIe Gen5 eye-opening values, 12 ps rise/fall time with about 29 GHz bandwidth, and that scopes are part of interface testing. The oscilloscope capability statements are explicitly framed as inferences and are reasonable, while the answer also notes that the passages do not provide formal oscilloscope model/spec requirements.
